content_html_sanitized:
The excellent website, MarijuanaMoment.net has an article, DEA Promotes Claim That Marijuana Causes Depression And Suicide, Shortly After New Administrator Is Sworn In that covers the latest Prohibitionist propaganda as described in the headline.

 

The backstory is more malpractice from Yale Medical School that I will cover later.

See Politicized Psychiatry and the Rehab Rackets

 

However, the more fundamental problem is the usual confusion of cause and effect in Prohibitionist propaganda. Remember the Gateway theory? Teenagers used hard drugs because they had used marijuana.

 

Now we are being told that using cannabis causes “depression and suicidality”.

 

However, we need to consider that this is a confusion of cause and effect. As more people have access to cannabis, especially seniors, there is more of a correlation between cannabis use and medical and psychological problems.

See

Scientific American Magazine Publishes Article by Respected Journalist on Study Showing Brain Changes Came Before Not After “Drug” Use. Difficult to Ignore.

And

Reading This Report Caused Me Anxiety. How Is Surprising That Medical Cannabis Helps People With Anxiety?

And

Massive New Study of California Cannabis Users Shows Continuum Between Recreational and Medical Use

 

And remember that current data would necessarily reflect the continued impact of the COVID pandemic.

Can Someone Please Talk About Using Cannabis to Relieve Pandemic Stress Disorder & Suicide?

 

Everything bad is caused by cannabis. Everything good is caused by arresting people. That’s why after 30 million marijuana arrests, everything is almost perfect.
